premises.text: Rising stakeholder scrutiny meets buyer blindness to supplier sustainability, producing scandal risk
premises.evidence_span: increasingly paying attention to supply chain sustainability problems, and companies have very little information and are flying blind

premises.text: An integrated platform gives buyers scorecards, risk weighting, and supplier management in one place
premises.evidence_span: helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk

premises.text: Supplier peer benchmarking plus buyer visibility across the network pressure suppliers to improve
premises.evidence_span: They know that with one click of a button, you, LexCorp, can see not only where they fit in your supply chain

premises.text: A unified scorecard library ends RFP fatigue so suppliers answer once and innovate instead
premises.evidence_span: we have a unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: The commercial model is an annual fee plus a small fee per supplier
premises.evidence_span: once suppliers enroll, they pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

value.text: Companies manage supply-chain sustainability and risk instead of flying blind into environmental scandals
value.evidence_span: evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better

secondary_value.text: More sustainable products reaching end buyers
secondary_value.evidence_span: make the products that you buy more sustainable

causal_links.evidence_span: These are all results of environmental problems in the supply chain.
drive their suppliers to be better

notes: Two-domain compact reading: the problem premise merges scrutiny and blindness (one market-condition claim), and the whole solution — platform, supplier incentive loops, scorecard library, and fee model — is one offering whose components the speaker presents as interlocking network effects that must be learned together. GRI statistics treated as context inside the scrutiny premise. Consulting background excluded as origin story.
